long_biography.plain_text:
Barry Sternlicht made hotel design central to the value-creation strategy of Starwood Hotels & Resorts. He developed W Hotels from a converted New York property and expanded St. Regis from a single hotel into an international brand. This work combined his investment discipline with the visual judgement he still applies to hotel and apartment renovations.

At Starwood Capital, Sternlicht remains chairman and chief executive while sharing leadership with president Jonathan Pollack. Most teams report to Pollack, but Sternlicht retains final decision-making authority and participates in investment decisions, strategy, senior hiring and restructuring. He expects his future role to emphasise the work he can do uniquely for the firm, especially design and investment judgement.
